scripts.lean:build: if command -v lake >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd lean && lake build); else echo '!!! lake not found: SKIPPING the Lean build. console-api tests need lean/.lake/build/bin/fwcore and fail without it (brew install elan-init, then cd lean && lake build).' >&2; fi
scripts.test: pnpm lean:build && node --test scripts/run-cite.test.mjs && pnpm -r --if-present test
